info.name: Dynamic Dental
info.description: Family, Cosmetic, Restorative & Emergency Dentistry in South East, Calgary. We are committed to providing quality personalized dental care for your whole family. We offer a wide range of general dentistry services including KoR Teeth Whitening, oral sedation, dental implants, crowns, dentures, sleep apnea & snoring appliances, veneers & teeth cleaning, just to name a few. Dr. Vranjes & Associates value your input and will work with you towards achieving & maintaining your long term dental health. We offer direct billing to your insurance, are open early AM, evenings & weekends and provide a modern, warm & friendly atmosphere. Whether you would like to improve your smile, correct dental problems, have a dental emergency or are looking for a family dentist, we have something for everyone. Dr. Vranjes also speaks fluent English, French & Croatian. We are warmly accepting new patients.
